hints.title: No-Zero Integer Definition
hints.text: A positive integer is non-zero if its decimal representation does not contain any digit zero.

hints.title: Iterate A from 1
hints.text: Iterate a from 1 to n - 1 and let b = n - a. Check if neither a nor b contains digit 0.

hints.title: Early Return
hints.text: The first pair (a, b) satisfying the condition can be returned immediately as any valid pair is accepted.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: There is no complex failure mode; search space is tiny since n <= 10000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Checking pairs incrementally stops in very few iterations because non-zero integers are dense.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks digit string representation or uses modulo 10 arithmetic cleanly.
complexity.notes: Guaranteed valid answer exists for any n >= 2.
